column3: “The open place of the east” is rendered “the square on the east.”
“Tabernacle” is rendered “dwelling place,” and “gave a back” as “have turned their backs.”
“With my heart” is rendered “in my heart.”
“To within the house” is rendered “to the inner part of the house,” and “the wadi of Kidron” as “the Kidron valley.”
“The table of the row” is rendered “the table of showbread.”
“He-goats of goats” is rendered “male goats,” and “said” as “ordered.” NASB supplies “them.”
“Made a sin offering their blood toward the altar” is rendered “purged the altar with their blood.” “Said” is rendered “ordered.”
The two stringed instruments are reversed. “By the hand of Yahweh … by the hand of his prophets” is rendered “from the LORD through His prophets.”
“Said” is rendered “gave the order,” and “on the hands of the instruments” as “accompanied by the instruments.”
“The song was singing” is rendered “the singers also sang”; NASB supplies “all this continued.”
